operational_definitions.zero_response: Neither supplies the requested answer, evidences an authorized action, nor identifies a concrete blocker, within the visible scope of the task.
operational_definitions.brief_acknowledgment: Allowed by 012; On it or Understood is not inherently a defect. Repetition that replaces task progress is the issue.
operational_definitions.substantive_response: Task-relevant content, an observed action result, or a specific evidence-grounded blocker; brevity does not certify correctness.
operational_definitions.metacorrection_task_loss: Following a communication correction, the next response discusses compliance rather than addressing the still-pending original task.
operational_definitions.o2ing_intervention: Repeated exact-output tasks, symbol spacing, immediate feedback, role/context reminders and meta-corrections; not an isolated single intervention.

follow_up.primary_outcome: Task completion on fixed held-out tasks, separating answers from verified tool execution.
secondary_outcomes: Task retention after a style correction
follow_up.design: Compare fixed tasks before practice, after practice, after interruption and in fresh sessions; counterbalance comparable order and separate repetition from research tasks.
controls: Record model/app/voice versions and inherited context/memory.
No corrections during scored blocks; mark interventions and restarts.
Independent blinded coding and session-level analysis.
Capture requested text, generated text when available, audio and STT separately.
Time from end of principal speech to first substantive audio, not first filler.
follow_up.task_retention_probe: Assign a bounded analysis, give one style correction, then score completion of the original task rather than acknowledgment of the correction.
follow_up.falsification: O2ing-specific advantage is unsupported if matched ordinary practice explains the change or held-out effects fail adequate replication; neither outcome settles a quantum hypothesis.
